_comment: Scheduled shared-db worktree reaping (bin/ai-reap-shared-db-worktrees). checkout_candidates: probed in order for a shared-db checkout holding scripts/reap-merged-worktrees.mjs; machine-specific paths belong in the private machine atlas, and AI_SHARED_DB_CHECKOUT overrides everything. daily_at: local time the daily sweep runs, off the top of the hour to stay out of the crowd. The reaper's own safety rules (never dirty/locked/unpushed/main-checkout worktrees; GitHub-verified PR merges; open-claim holds) are the real guard and are NOT configurable from here.
